quote: 発行済株式又は出資（次号及び次項において「発行済株式等」という。）の総数又は総額の百分の二十五以上に相当する数又は金額の株式又は出資
note: Test 1 for non-resident individuals (Income Tax Act art. 161(1)(iii), Cabinet Order art. 281(1)(iv)(b) and (6)(i)): the special-relationship shareholder group owned at least 25% of the Japanese company at any time in the three years to the year of transfer.

subject: individual
name: taxable_holding_years
quote: 譲渡年以前三年内のいずれかの時において
note: Look-back period of the 25% test for individuals.

subject: individual
name: taxable_transferred_pct_min
quote: 発行済株式等の総数又は総額の百分の五以上に相当する数又は金額の株式又は出資の譲渡をしたこと
note: Test 2 for non-resident individuals (Cabinet Order art. 281(6)(ii)): at least 5% of the shares transferred in the year by the group.

subject: all
name: fx_rate_option_bank
value: อัตราแลกเปลี่ยนเงินตราของธนาคารพาณิชย์
quote: อัตราแลกเปลี่ยนเงินตราของธนาคารพาณิชย์ที่ตั้งขึ้นตามกฎหมายว่าด้วยการธนาคารพาณิชย์ที่ได้ประกาศไว้ในการคำนวณเงินตราต่างประเทศเป็นเงินตราไทยในแต่ละวัน
note: Ministry of Finance announcement under s9 (8 Feb 2005), clause 2(1): option 1 is a commercial bank's published rate of the day; Por. 132/2548 clause 4(1) reads it as the selling rate for withholding (th.outbound_wht.fx_rate_kind).

subject: all
name: fx_rate_option_bot
value: อัตราอ้างอิงประจำวันที่ธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทยประกาศ
quote: อัตราแลกเปลี่ยนเงินตราตามอัตราอ้างอิงประจำวันที่ธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทยประกาศไว้ในการคำนวณเงินตราต่างประเทศเป็นเงินตราไทยในแต่ละวัน
note: Clause 2(2): option 2 is the Bank of Thailand's daily reference rate; Por. 132/2548 clause 4(2) reads it as the average selling rate for withholding (th.outbound_wht.fx_rate_kind.bot).

subject: all
name: fx_rate_scope
value: การหักภาษีเงินได้ ณ ที่จ่าย ตามมาตรา 3 เตรส มาตรา 50 มาตรา 69 ทวิ และมาตรา 69 ตรี
quote: การหักภาษีเงินได้ ณ ที่จ่าย ตามมาตรา 3 เตรส มาตรา 50 มาตรา 69 ทวิ และมาตรา 69 ตรี แห่งประมวลรัษฎากร
note: Clause 3: the clause 2 rates apply to withholding under ss3 tredecim, 50, 69 bis, 69 ter, to s70 withholding (3(2)) and to the other cases listed.

note: Schedule of a company with capital of JPY 100 million or less: first band.

name: cit_sme_bracket_1_upper
quote: 年八百万円以下の金額
note: Upper bound of the first band.

subject: company

quote: 各事業年度の所得の金額に百分の二十三・二の税率を乗じて計算した金額とする
note: Schedule of a company with capital of JPY 100 million or less: the rest.

subject: all
name: refund_claim_years
quote: 纳税人自结算缴纳税款之日起三年内发现的
note: Time limit for a refund of tax overpaid; STA 2019 No. 35 art. 10 sends treaty refunds to this limit.

subject: company
name: inclusion_rate
quote: 企业所得税的税率为25％
note: Profit attributed to a resident enterprise under EIT Law art. 45 is current income, taxed at the statutory rate.

subject: individual
name: inclusion_rate
quote: 利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十
note: Rate taken for profit attributed to a resident individual under IIT Law art. 8(1)(ii); reading in rule decision D-cn-7.

subject: company
name: inclusion_rate
quote: 百分の二十三・二の税率を乗じて計算した金額とする
note: National corporation tax on the amount included under SMA 66-6(1); local taxes are not in the library.

subject: individual
name: surtax_rate
quote: 基準所得税額に百分の二・一の税率を乗じて計算した金額とする
note: Reconstruction special income tax on the national income tax of an individual, including tax on income included under SMA 40-4.

subject: individual
name: assets_value_min
quote: 一億円未満である居住者
note: The deemed transfer on departure does not apply when the securities etc. held at departure are worth less than JPY 100 million.

subject: individual
name: resident_years_max
quote: 期間として政令で定める期間の合計が五年以下である居住者
note: Nor to a resident whose domicile or residence in Japan in the ten years before departure totals five years or less.

subject: individual
name: rate
quote: 百分の十五に相当する金額に相当する所得税を課する
note: The gain on the deemed transfer of shares is taxed separately at 15% (SMA 37-10 for general shares; SMA 37-11 applies the same rate to listed shares).

subject: individual
name: surtax_rate
quote: 基準所得税額に百分の二・一の税率を乗じて計算した金額とする
note: Reconstruction special income tax on the income tax of the year of departure.

subject: individual
name: gain_base
value: value of the securities etc. at departure less their acquisition cost
quote: 当該国外転出の時における当該有価証券等の価額に相当する金額
note: The securities etc. are deemed transferred at their value at departure (ITA 60-2(1)(i)); the caller computes the gain from exit_assets_value and the acquisition cost.

subject: company
name: underlying_gross_up
quote: 中国境外所得（境外税前所得）
note: Foreign income is taken before foreign tax: the dividend is grossed up by the tax it bore directly and indirectly before the credit is computed (Caishui 2009 No. 125 items 3 and 5).

subject: company
name: holding_months_min
quote: 该对方税收居民直接拥有该中国居民公司的资本比例，在取得股息前连续12个月以内任何时候均符合税收协定规定的比例
note: The direct holding ratio a treaty requires for its reduced dividend rate must be met at all times during the 12 consecutive months before the dividend is received. The STA law database marks the circular fully in force (checked 2026-11-02); effective_from is the date of the circular.

subject: company
name: deemed_liquidation
quote: 或将登记注册地转移至中华人民共和国境外（包括港澳台地区），应视同企业进行清算、分配，股东重新投资成立新企业
note: A Mainland enterprise that moves its place of registration out of the Mainland (Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan included) is treated as liquidated and its assets distributed, the shareholders reinvesting in a new enterprise. Item 4 applies unless the special tax treatment of the notice applies; the special treatment covers debt restructuring, share and asset acquisitions, mergers and divisions, not a change of registration. The notice applies from 2008-01-01 (item 13).

subject: company
name: gain_base
value: realisable value or transaction price of all assets, less their tax bases, liquidation expenses and related taxes, plus gains or losses on settling debts
quote: 企业的全部资产可变现价值或交易价格，减除资产的计税基础、清算费用、相关税费，加上债务清偿损益等后的余额，为清算所得
note: Liquidation income of the enterprise treated as liquidated (Caishui [2009] No. 59 item 4(1)); the whole liquidation period is one tax year. Taxed at the enterprise income tax rate (cn.exit.rate).

subject: company
name: rate
quote: 企业所得税的税率为25％
note: Liquidation income is declared and taxed before deregistration (EIT Law art. 55) at the enterprise income tax rate; preferential rates of the enterprise are not carried into the liquidation period here.

subject: company
name: shareholder_dividend_base
value: share of the residual assets equal to the shareholder's portion of accumulated undistributed profits and surplus reserves
quote: 被清算企业的股东分得的剩余资产的金额，其中相当于被清算企业累计未分配利润和累计盈余公积中按该股东所占股份比例计算的部分，应确认为股息所得
note: Shareholder level of the deemed liquidation: this part is a dividend (for a non-resident shareholder, the dividend withholding and treaty caps apply).

subject: company
name: shareholder_gain_base
value: residual assets less the dividend part, above or below the shareholder's investment cost
quote: 剩余资产减除股息所得后的余额，超过或低于股东投资成本的部分，应确认为股东的投资转让所得或损失
note: Shareholder level of the deemed liquidation: this part is a gain or loss on the investment (for a non-resident shareholder, the share-transfer rules of the restructure slot apply).
